name: Registry Export Inspector
description: Read-only inspector for Windows .reg export files with two-file comparison
help: Parses only the .reg text you provide (Registry Editor 5.00) and never touches the local registry; REGEDIT4 is explicitly unsupported.
Distinguishes REG_SZ / DWORD / QWORD / BINARY / EXPAND_SZ / MULTI_SZ and unknown types; integers are shown in decimal and hex, multi-strings keep their boundaries.

Comparison matches key paths and value names case-insensitively while preserving original spelling, and separates type changes from data changes; missing on one side does not mean it was deleted from the live registry.
Delete-key and delete-value statements plus duplicate assignments are labelled as operation declarations; such files are not a final state snapshot.

values.title: Values
values.empty: Select a key to inspect its values
values.emptyHint: Values show their type, interpreted data and source line

diff.title: Comparison
diff.identical: The two files have no differences
diff.deleteHint: The file contains delete statements; treat it as an operation script, not a state snapshot.
diff.emptyHint: Differences are grouped into type changes, data changes and one-sided presence
